description: This file defines the 'OmrData' class, which models the data encoded within an Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) code. It provides methods for adding mark descriptions, initializing mark data, setting and unsetting marks, and accessing mark states. The class also includes a static method for creating test data with predefined marks.

classes.name: OmrData
classes.description: Represents the data encoded within the OMR code, supporting mark description management, initialization, and mark status manipulation.

methods.name: ForTesting
methods.description: Provides a static instance of OmrData populated with test mark descriptions, useful for unit testing or debugging.

methods.name: AddMarkDescription
methods.description: Adds a new mark description given its name, mapping it to an internal index.

methods.name: InitMarks
methods.description: Initializes the internal boolean array to represent the marks, setting up the data structure for mark status management.

methods.name: FindIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a mark given its name, initializing marks if necessary.

methods.name: SetMark
methods.description: Marks a specific OMR code by name as set (true).

methods.name: UnsetMark
methods.description: Marks a specific OMR code by name as unset (false).
